event.text: Go to the emergency department now. Sudden painless loss of vision in one eye that hasn't returned can be a blocked retinal artery (a stroke-equivalent) or a retinal detachment, and treatment is time-critical. Do not drive yourself — have someone take you or call 911, especially if you develop weakness, facial droop, numbness or trouble speaking.
